working_title: Topology-Conditioned Recovery Options with Exposure Shaping for Heterogeneous UAV Coordination
research_question: When a communication-support path degrades during an ongoing heterogeneous UAV mission, can a team select a topology-conditioned recovery option from legal local observations and benefit from training exposure shaping?

scope.mission: two sequential objectives requiring fresh, legally delivered task support
scope.event: a topology degradation occurs after initial task progress but before both objectives are complete
not_this_work: fault-label lookup or global graph access at execution
macro fault-to-action regression over a scripted payoff table
a retrospective upgrade of completed DRTP evidence

recovery_options.continue: retain assignments and nominal relay position
recovery_options.relay_reposition: move the relay to a legal bridging location, temporarily sacrificing forwarding capacity
recovery_options.role_reassign: transfer a sensing/forwarding responsibility to a surviving platform, incurring service interruption
recovery_options.safe_fallback: complete the currently supportable objective and abandon the unsupported objective before timeout

permitted: own and directly observed teammate kinematics
received message age and acknowledgement history
locally observed objective progress and action masks
prohibited: global adjacency matrix outside local incident links
future trajectory or future link state

formal_2x2.UTR_direct: uniform topology exposure and no explicit recovery-option layer
formal_2x2.DRTP_direct: DRTP exposure and no explicit recovery-option layer
formal_2x2.UTR_recovery: uniform exposure with the recovery-option layer
formal_2x2.DRTP_recovery: full method: recovery-option layer plus DRTP exposure

stage0_gates.fault_injected_after_progress: at least 90% of designated fault episodes have nonzero pre-fault progress and a recorded degradation before terminal completion
stage0_gates.nontrivial_option_regions: at least three recovery options are uniquely optimal in at least 10% of a frozen physical-context grid
stage0_gates.no_universal_option: no option is optimal in more than 65% of frozen contexts
stage0_gates.option_headroom: per-context recovery oracle exceeds the best fixed option by at least 0.08 normalized mission value
stage0_gates.legal_information_sufficiency: the permitted observation set predicts no more than an action-relevant uncertainty bound fixed before inspection; no forbidden feature may be used
stage0_gates.endpoint_dynamic_range: nominal and degraded cases are both non-ceiling and non-global-failure under scripted feasibility witnesses
stage0_gates.dense_natural_progress: objective-progress and delivered-support signals vary before terminal outcome; no recovery-specific bonus reward is allowed

stage1_gate.baseline_learnability: at least 2 of 3 UTR-direct seeds achieve the frozen nominal and degraded learnability ranges without ceiling saturation

stop_rule: If any Stage-0 gate fails, close P20 without algorithm training. If Stage-1 baseline learnability fails or saturates, redesign the task before candidate training; do not tune the method to rescue the task.
